title: Wavex Car Wash & Wax Shampoo 1L with 2-in-1 Microfiber Wash Mitt | pH Neutral Formula | Wet Look Shine, Smooth Finish & Water Spot-Free Wash | Reusable Glove for Cars & Bikes
description: Keep your vehicle looking clean, glossy and well-maintained with the WaveX Car Wash & Wax Combo. This convenient kit combines a premium pH-neutral Wash & Wax Car Shampoo with a Dual-Sided Microfiber Wash Mitt to deliver an efficient and safe cleaning experience for cars and bikes. The Wash & Wax Shampoo effectively removes dirt, dust, road film and everyday contaminants while enhancing the vehicle's shine in a single wash. Its pH-neutral formulation is gentle on paintwork and compatible with waxed, sealed and coated surfaces. The rich foaming action helps lift dirt away from the paint, reducing the chances of scratches while leaving behind a wet-look shine and smooth finish. The included 2-in-1 Microfiber Wash Mitt is designed for superior cleaning performance. Its soft microfiber side safely traps dirt and debris, while the opposite side can be used for wax application and detailing tasks. The mitt is reusable, machine washable and comfortable to use, making routine vehicle maintenance easier and more effective. Ideal for regular washing and maintenance, the WaveX Car Wash & Wax Combo helps keep your vehicle clean, glossy and protected with every wash.
